held_list.headline: Because of AI, 52% of students with elevated depressive symptoms who used a generative-AI coaching app for six weeks improved meaningfully, against 32% given care as usual.
Because of AI, the Hurricane Center called a Category 5 landfall in Jamaica about three days out, while Melissa was still a Category 1.
Because of AI, Oman screened 43,000 diabetics for retinopathy, flagged 12,000 for treatment, and cut specialist waiting lists by 87%.

Because of AI, specialist consultations at two hospitals in western China took 3.14 minutes instead of 4.41 when patients first gave their history to a chatbot, and patients rated communication easier.
held_list.detail: evidence: drafter A, verifier could not grade.

leads_added: Leveraging technology to enhance access to financial advice (trust, uptake, advisor adoption). [AEARCTR-0018280](https://www.socialscienceregistry.org/trials/18280) (AEA RCT Registry, in development, 2026-05-20 to 2026-12-31). Protocol to watch: a field experiment with AI in financial advice. Missing: results, achieved dates, absolute effects.

AI and the fight against disinformation: experiment 2. [AEARCTR-0020071](https://www.socialscienceregistry.org/trials/20071) (in development, 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-12). Protocol to watch; an information experiment, probably outside the four tests.

MERIT, multi-agent EHR-grounded risk identification for early cognitive decline in primary care. [medRxiv](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.11.02.26367125v1) (2026-11-03). Check whether it was used in real clinics; likely a retrospective model study. Missing: deployment, comparison, patient outcomes.

Skipped: systematic reviews (smoking cessation, LVO stroke, drowning detection, radiomics meta-analysis), retrospective model validations (cardiac MRI segmentation, osteonecrosis, lung cancer screening intervals, ILD, schistosomiasis ultrasound, ECG foundation models, mammography triage), benchmarks and commentary, an AI-moderated interviews methods preprint, ERIC chatbot education items (no add date, already seen).
